QuestInfo.name: Garden of Vengeance
QuestInfo.0: Shane is below Anne. Talk to Shane.
QuestInfo.1: You are the cold hand of justice! Annihilate the Cold Eyes of the North Forest Lot for ruining Shane's garden and collect #b20 Herb Seeds#k.
QuestInfo.2: Shane's Herb Seeds were okay. Next up is Dr. Betty, Anne's mother.\r\n#b(You can check her location by clicking the 'NPC' button on the mini map on the upper left.)

0.0: What're YOU looking at? Huh? HUH?!\r\n#L0##bI'm here to help.#l\n#k
0.1: Ha! You think you can help me? You know what it's like to have the best rare herb garden in the whole wide world? To have herbs so awesome that even Sabitrama from Sleepywood wanted some, and then lose it all?\r\n#L0##bWhat tragedy befell your herbs?#l\n#k
0.2: Those #bCold Eye#k jerks are to blame! They busted into my garden and tore everything up, then ran off with the seeds. If I can't get those seeds back, I'm ruined. RUINED, you hear me?!

yes.0: 20 seeds! That's all I ask for. Just 20 seeds!

no.0: I thought you were gonna help me!!

1.0: Gimme! Gimme gimme gimme!\r\n#L0##bTake good care of these seeds.#l\n#k
1.1: Yeah! I won't forget this. Thanks forever!

yes.0: Have you talked to Dr. Betty? She looks like she could use some help.\r\n#b(Dr. Betty is above Shane and to the left of Anne.)

item.0: If you don't hurry, the Cold Eyes will eat all my Herb Seeds. Hurry hurry hurry!
